item.title: Named executor? Start here. | Estate Executor Kit
item.description: Named executor? Start here.. A calm, step-by-step system for settling an estate. Estate Executor Kit: a step-by-step executor checklist and estate organizer spreadsheet for Google Sheets and Excel. 54 pre-written tasks, accounts to close, assets and debts, estate ledger, beneficiary distribution, 8 letter templates and printable checklists. Instant digital download.
